title: Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 – The Pusad Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd., Pusad, Dist. Yavatmal, Maharashtra – Extension of Period
description: The Reserve Bank of India issued Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 to The Pusad Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd., Pusad, Dist. Yavatmal, Maharashtra vide Directive No. NGP.DOS.SSM3.No.S611/5-04-166/2025-2026 dated November 06, 2025, for a period of six months up to close of business on May 07, 2026, which was last extended up to the close of business on August 07, 2026 vide Directive No. DOR.MON/D-11/12-22-635/2026-27 dated April 30, 2026.
